messages:
pagerbot: [ALERT] High error rate detected for org=nereid-labs on /generate (5xxs rising). QPS ~8x baseline, 20% 5xx in last 2m. Paging oncall. incident_id=INC-2026-1473

oncall-jordan: acknowledging. jumping in — will triage. tagging @sre-maya @eng-runtime-luca

sre-maya: on it. confirm: affected endpoint = /v1/generate-stream? we seeing KV cache thrash and OOM retries from runtime?

eng-runtime-luca: yes, logs show sustained token-level CPU/backpressure and repeated model fallback attempts. suspect a request pattern hammering long-context gen.

product-eli: quick ask — any customer-facing failures (timeouts vs degraded responses)? want to prep comms if we escalate.

customer-success-ana: Nereid reports users getting 500s and stalled sessions. they're on a bursty ML pipeline; alerted our support at 12:02.

oncall-jordan: mitigation plan: 1) apply temporary org-level rate softcap (10rps -> 60rps) for Nereid to smooth bursts 2) disable noncritical streaming feature 'delta-stream' for their org 3) observe 10m, rollback if errors <2%

eng-runtime-luca: I can apply the softcap via admin API. command below (will run after +2 approvals):

```bash
# set org softcap
curl -X POST "https://admin.internal/api/v1/orgs/nereid-labs/rl-override" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"soft_cap_rps":60, "duration_minutes":30, "reason":"emergency surge mitigation"}'
```

infra-kim: note: this will increase billing burn; also watch quota engine for secondary effects. recommend alerting billing team if we hold >30m.

sre-maya: +1 from me. also propose flipping a feature flag to prevent large-batched streaming at edge: `flags.disable_nereid_delta_stream = true`

customer-success-ana: Nereid gives permission to apply mitigations and wants updates in-thread. they asked for ETA ~10m to see impact.

oncall-jordan: @product-eli you ok with temporary feature disable? we need signoff for user-experience tradeoff.

product-eli: ok to disable delta-stream for now — degrade UX slightly but preserves availability. proceed. :thumbsup:

eng-runtime-luca: applying RL override now. will post logs.

[~30s later]

eng-runtime-luca: done — API returned 200. override_id=ovr-790123-a1. patch: soft_cap_rps=60 duration=30m.

sre-maya: flipping flag in feature-store for org. command:

```py
# feature toggle
fs.set_org_flag('nereid-labs', 'disable_delta_stream', True)
```

[~15s]

sre-maya: flag flip complete. confirmed via feature-store API.

oncall-jordan: monitoring metrics dashboard. initial drop in 5xx from 20% -> 6% over 3m. latency at p95 still elevated but trending down. good sign.

infra-kim: billing alerted for possible override >30m. we'll keep them in loop.

customer-success-ana: relayed to Nereid: applied temporary cap + disabled streaming. they're appreciative and watching.

product-eli: please capture this as an emergency hotfix in our incident tracker and assign follow-ups to runtime and product for root cause and UX recovery.

oncall-jordan: creating incident ticket INC-2026-1473 (hotfix: RL override + feature disable). linking runbook: https://docs.internal/runbooks/rate-mitigation

eng-runtime-luca: note: we saw a client pattern sending large concatenated prompts with keep-alive trick — will instrument to block that pattern and add a backpressure rule.

sre-maya: keeping watch. if errors <2% for 10m we can transition to monitoring and let override expire.

[~10m later]

oncall-jordan: follow-up: 5xx now ~1.8%, p95 down 40%. override will auto-expire in 14m. plan: let it expire, keep flag off until we deploy a safer streaming cap.

customer-success-ana: Nereid confirmed user flow restored. asked for post-incident summary when available.

product-eli: schedule postmortem session tomorrow 10:00 PT. runtime + product + cs. action items: (1) add backpressure rule for long concat prompts (eng-runtime-luca) (2) design user-friendly degraded streaming fallback (product-eli) (3) billing impact report (infra-kim)

oncall-jordan: wrapping up the on-call handoff: @oncall-jordan -> @sre-maya for overnight watch. leaving notes in incident ticket.

sre-maya: acknowledged handoff. will keep an eye and escalate if regressions.

oncall-jordan: resolved: mitigation successful, customer stable. next steps captured in INC-2026-1473. ending active paging. :white_check_mark:
